title: Divide fractions
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Write every answer in simplest form.

items.prompt: You have {3/4} of a pound of trail mix. You put {1/8} of a pound in each bag. How many bags can you fill?
A ribbon 6 feet long is cut into pieces that are each {2/3} of a foot long. How many pieces are there?
Half a gallon of juice ({1/2} gallon) is poured into cups that each hold {1/10} of a gallon. How many cups can be filled?
Maria says 6 ÷ {1/2} = 3. Is she right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: 12 (No: 6 ÷ 1/2 asks how many halves fit into 6, which is 12; 3 is 6 × 1/2)
